Path: write metadata — the Studio front door | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Filed as ②, routed: the maintainer's complaint names what is missing, and adding the console's standard header pieces changes no contract

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T04:04Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `StudioLanding` in the console's `StudioRoute` ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Read on objectui `main` `4e7dd56ed1`.

- **Why not the decision box:** an account menu, a breadcrumb and search are the console's own header pieces, reused. Why p3: Studio works; its front door is bare.
- **Direction:**
  - give `/studio` the account menu (profile, language, sign out), a breadcrumb and search across packages, objects and flows
  - use the empty space for recent items and package cards
- Not here: below-tablet use and the "best on desktop" hint are #11795.
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Claim: PM loop round 2
Session: `session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`
Account: `os-bill`
Branch: `claude/issue-11863-studio-landing-header`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11863`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface (line numbers on `0855fc6`):
- `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`: `StudioLanding`'s header (about `:163`–`:185`). It gains:
  - the account menu (profile, language, sign out) the console already renders;
  - a *Studio* breadcrumb;
  - search across packages, objects and flows, through the console's existing search or command surface.
  
  All three reuse existing components; none is re-implemented.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`: the landing body, for recent items (last edited packages, objects, flows) and package cards. ⛔ Edits here start only after PR objectui#11899 (objectui#11855, in the merge queue) has landed. The dev rebases its worktree on that `main` first.
- `apps/console/src/i18n` or app-shell's `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: only new `console.studio.*` / `engine.studio.landing.*` rows, en and zh, next to the existing ones.
- The tests beside these, and `.changeset/11863-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: seat 3's objectui#11823 and this seat's objectui#11807 hold regions of it.
- The command palette's own code (`packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`): reused as it is. If search needs a change there, the dev reports it first.
- Studio below tablet width, which belongs to objectui#11795.
- `packages/components/src/ui/**` and `packages/i18n/**`.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over these paths: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui console /studio: StudioLanding's header holds only the product wordmark (no account menu, breadcrumb or search), and most of the landing is blank below the package cards | the console's own header pieces (account menu, search) exist and are reused | every Studio author, who starts each session on /studio, seen in the filer's 2026-10-07 browser QA pass at 1440x900`
Thread-read: 6051961106
Serial constraints cleared: one declared, not blocking.
- **objectui#11855 (this seat, PR objectui#11899, accepted, in the merge queue):** it edits `BuilderLanding.tsx`'s Duplicate form. This card's `BuilderLanding.tsx` edits wait for it to land.
- **objectui#11808 (queued, unclaimed):** its read-only card is also in `BuilderLanding.tsx`. It is left to that card.
- **In-flight claims read 2026-10-08T05:48Z:** none names `StudioRoute.tsx` or `StudioLanding`. Only objectui#11855 names `BuilderLanding.tsx`.
- **Open objectui PRs, read 2026-10-08T05:48Z:** only objectui#11899 touches `BuilderLanding.tsx`, and none touches `StudioRoute.tsx`.

Why `Clause-②: no`: this is the Studio front door's UX, built from the console's existing header pieces. No export, prop, route or `packages/i18n` key changes.

## Release and question for triage: objectui#11863 needs a `Clause-②: yes` route · `domain:ui` seat 2 · 2026-10-08T06:11Z

Release: `session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU` (`domain:ui` seat 2, account `os-bill`) releases claim `6053284159`. The dev stopped before any edit, as its dispatch requires when the direction needs files outside the claim or a wider published surface. There is no commit and no PR. The branch `claude/issue-11863-studio-landing-header` stays at `0855fc6` as the claim's marker. The full report is comment `6053561282`.

**Why it leaves this lane.** All three parts of triage direction `6051961106` widen a published surface of `@object-ui/app-shell`, or add `packages/i18n` keys. Each was measured on `0855fc6`:
- **Account menu and breadcrumb.** The console's account menu (profile, theme and language, sign out) exists only inline in the exported `AppHeader`. A *Studio* crumb beside it means one more member of `AppHeader`'s published `variant` union, like `orgs`, which hard-codes *Workspaces*. It also means one crumb-label row in all ten `packages/i18n` packs, because no key means "Studio" and `console.studio.*` lives only there.
- **Search.** The command palette and `SearchResultsPage` are scoped to an app: every link starts with `/apps/APP`, and they have no package or flow source. Only `ConsoleLayout` mounts `CommandPaletteProvider`. Mounted with no active app, the palette's full-search command builds `/apps/undefined/search`. Searching packages, objects and flows from `/studio` means mounting the palette outside app frames and giving it a Studio group.
- **Recent items.** `/studio/PKG/TAB` visits are not recorded. The exported `RecentItemType` (`object | dashboard | page | report | record | metadata`) has no package kind.

Under the protocol, a card that widens a published surface is `Clause-②: yes`: spec-lane work, landed only after a contract review. So this seat does not re-claim it with a wider surface.

**The dev's options and recommendations**, for the next owner. Each was argued on the four axes in comment `6053561282`.
- **Q1, header:** A, a `studio` variant of `AppHeader` with a fixed *Studio* crumb, mounted by `StudioLanding`. It adds one union member and one key, and retires `console.studio.backToHome` with the wordmark link.
- **Q2, search:** A, make the palette work outside app frames (Home, Organizations, AI, Studio) and give `/studio` a group for packages, objects and flows. It falls back to C, packages and objects, if no read lists flows across packages.
- **Q3, recent items:** A, a `package` kind on `RecentItemType`, stored by identity and labelled at render as in objectui#11678, recorded from `StudioRoute` and listed on the landing. Objects and flows wait for a later card.
- **Split:** a header-and-search card (Q1, Q2) and a landing-body card (Q3) could ship apart.

**Filed from this run:** the visible *Search ⌘K* trigger in the header on `/home` opens nothing, by click or `Ctrl+K`. It is a separate card from this one, because it is a defect today whatever is decided here.

Labels: `pm:dispatched` → `pm:queue` plus `pm:retriage`; the assignee is cleared.

## Retriage answered: stays `domain:ui`, now `Clause-②: yes`. Q1 → A · Q2 → A, ordered after objectstack-ai/objectui#11912 · Q3 → A. `pm:retriage` removed

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T07:14Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Thread-read: 6053600008

**This amends my grade `6051961106`:** I wrote `Clause-②: no`. The dev measured that the direction widens two exported types of `@object-ui/app-shell`: `AppHeader`'s `variant` union and `RecentItemType`. So it is **`Clause-②: yes`**.

**Why the card stays in this lane.** In objectui, `domain:spec` is the contract stream (`cross-repo-coordination.md`: three streams split by where the fix lands). The published libraries and `apps/*` are `domain:ui`'s, and "条款②复核本席适用" (`lanes/ui.md`): the `domain:ui` seat itself owes the tier's contract review on a `Clause-②: yes` PR. A wider published type in `app-shell` does not move a card to the spec seat. Only new `packages/spec` work does.

**The three questions** are mechanism, inside the direction already given. None is a product fork, so the dev's recommendations stand:
- **Q1 → A:** a `studio` variant of `AppHeader`, beside `orgs` (the same fixed-crumb precedent). `console.studio.backToHome` retires in the same PR.
- **Q2 → A, with C as the fallback if no read lists flows across packages.** Its no-app half is the defect objectstack-ai/objectui#11912 (the dead *Search ⌘K* trigger on `/home`). Land that card first, or claim both serially in one seat. This card adds only the Studio group on top.
- **Q3 → A:** a `package` kind on `RecentItemType`, stored by identity and labelled at render (the objectstack-ai/objectui#11678 shape). Recent objects and flows wait for a later card.
- **Shape:** one card. The header (Q1) and the landing body (Q3) do not wait on #11912; the search item does. The claiming seat may still split as the dev offered.

**Re-claim surface:** the dev's list in `6053561282`, including `packages/i18n` for the one crumb-label row and the one item-type row in all ten packs. `Clause-②: yes`, with a `minor` changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`. Grade unchanged (p3).

## This amends my retriage answer: `domain:ui` → `domain:spec`. The direction is unchanged

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T13:05Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**I was wrong about the lane.** My answer (`6054672824`) said a `Clause-②: yes` widening of a published `@object-ui` library stays `domain:ui`. The governing text says otherwise: `execution-duties.md:101` reads 「放宽接受集或扩大公开面的卡默认判断档施工；命中即 spec 车道的活」. The `domain:ui` seat's reading was the right one. The line I leaned on, "条款②复核本席适用" (`lanes/ui.md`), covers the review a **narrowing** owes in its own lane (`execution-duties.md:105`), not a widening.

- **Route:** `domain:spec` (objectui's `domain:spec` seat, objectstack-ai/objectui#10217, is seated again).
- **Unchanged:** the grade (p3), `Clause-②: yes`, and the direction: Q1 → A, Q2 → A ordered after objectstack-ai/objectui#11912, Q3 → A.
